subject: science
cluster: Living things, weather, and caring for Earth
skillName: Living Things and Where They Live

items.prompt:
Animals live in certain places because those places
A) give them what they need
B) are always warm
C) have no food
D) are empty
items.answer: A) give them what they need

steps: Animals live where their needs are met.

items.prompt:
A fish lives in water because it needs water to
A) breathe and swim
B) fly
C) dig
D) climb

A cactus lives in the
A) dry desert
B) deep ocean
C) snowy pole
D) rainforest swamp

steps: A cactus needs little water, so it lives in the desert.

items.prompt:
A polar bear lives where it is
A) hot and dry
B) cold and snowy
C) underwater
D) in a tree

steps: A polar bear is suited to cold, snowy places.

items.prompt:
A model matching a bird to a tree shows that the tree
A) meets the bird's needs
B) has no use
C) is too cold
D) has no food

steps: The tree gives the bird shelter and food.

items.prompt:
A camel is best matched to a
A) dry desert
B) deep ocean
C) snowy pole
D) pond

steps: Camels live where it is dry.

items.prompt:
A fish would NOT live in a dry desert because
A) it is too sunny
B) there is no water to breathe and swim in
C) it is too quiet
D) there is too much water
items.answer: B) there is no water to breathe and swim in

steps: The desert does not meet the fish's need for water.

items.prompt:
The BEST reason a place is a good home for an animal is that it
A) looks nice
B) gives the animal what it needs
C) is far away
D) is big
items.answer: B) gives the animal what it needs

steps: A good home meets the animal's needs.
